meta.name: swams-design-tokens
meta.source: design second part: SWAMS_Unified.html (`:root` dark block + `html[data-theme="light"]` block), reconciled with docs/FRONTEND_PROMPT.md Section 8.2.
notes: 2026-10-11: palette re-derived from the owner's SWAMS_Unified.html so the app matches the prototype. Names are kept stable — only values and a few additions changed — so components did not have to be rewritten.
brand is the prototype's `--lime` (#2E5CFF / #2748D6): the primary-button and hero-stat colour. It is named for its role, not its swatch.

textFaint, primary and the *Text variants are nudged a few steps off the prototype's raw values because the prototype's #5a6380 / #4f6ef7 land at 3.2:1 and 4.5:1-ish, under this repo's >= 4.5:1 rule (Section 8.2). Deltas are small enough to read as the same design; see docs/design/token-diff.md.
chip soft/strong pairs remain OPINION: the prototype inlines rgba(tint, .12) per badge rather than defining pairs.

2026-10-12: light borders one step stronger (border #E2E5EE→#D9DEEA, borderStrong #CBD1E0→#B6BFD2). A white card on #F6F7FB is only 1.07:1, so the hairline is the ONLY thing that bounds most components in light mode; at the old value they read as blank space. Text contrast pairs are unchanged (borders are not text).

2026-10-12: every hex colour emits an `-rgb` channel triple so Tailwind can apply an alpha (`bg-primary/15`). maxWidthPage (84rem) is the product-page measure; maxWidthCh (70ch) stays for text-first screens (auth, wizard, error pages).

2026-10-12: surfaceSunken dark #1A1E28→#1F2534. A sunken panel (chat bubble, week-strip cell, meeting row, search field) sits on a surface, and #1A1E28 on the dark surface #13161D is 1.05:1 — a filled box with no edge anyone can find. e2e/contrast.spec.js caught it on six pages; the new value is 1.18:1 against surface and 1.25:1 against bg, so the plane reads without a border. Light is unchanged (#EEF0F7 on white is 1.12:1). textFaint dark #8089A3→#8A93AD goes with it: the lighter plane cost the weakest grey 0.11 (4.39:1 on surfaceSunken), and this buys it back to 5.0:1 onevery dark surface.

2026-10-12: surfaceSunken dark #1F2534→#252B3A. The earlier value was tuned against `surface` only, but a sunken row inside a Card sits on `surfaceRaised` (#1E2230) — and #1F2534 on #1E2230 is 1.03:1, the same invisible-panel failure one plane up. The new value is 1.12:1 against surfaceRaised, 1.28:1 against surface and 1.36:1 against bg, so a sunken box reads on every dark plane; textFaint dark holds at 4.6:1 on it (the pair test asserts it). Light is unchanged.

2026-10-12: stage* is the video room — a dark surface in BOTH themes, the way every meeting product draws a call stage, so a shared screen or a face is never washed out by a light page around it. Contrast pairs are asserted in the token tests.

nav* is the prototype's sidebar: --bg2 rail (white in light, per the prototype's `--bg2:#ffffff`), the brand blue active pill, --text3 section labels. navActiveBg is one step off #4F6EF7 in dark because white on it lands at 4.28:1.
